nextStoryContext: US-002 depends on US-001 (ensurePushed already wired). It needs to add the 'pushed' WorkerEventKind to events.ts and call emit('pushed', ...) after ensurePushed in both pass-branch sites. The emit helper already guards on logEvent absence. Event ordering: 'result' first, then writeSessionMarker, then ensurePushed, then emit('pushed'). Use outcome.storyId (exit mode) or sentinelOutcome.storyId (sentinel mode), not advisoryStoryId.
